{{Top|leg}}
The '''Entyrmion''' was a vast, labyrinthine cavern complex located under the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The natives of Skye, the [[S'kytri]], regarded the Entyrmion as their [[Chaos/Legends|underworld]], and, as such, it was off limits. According to the [[S'kytri mythology]], the surface of Skye was originally ruled by chaotic monstruosities, which ended up being locked up in the Entyrmion by the hero [[Hormaket]] the Vanquisher.
